name: Dai Kobayakawa-san wa Soulslike
original_name: 大早川さんはソウルライク
source:
Third and final game of the trilogy where you battle through conversations with the girl you like using:

Light Attack / Heavy Attack / Parry / Roll.

This time, Kobayakawa-san is very, very big.

You can still choose the same four combat commands—but ordinary attacks barely affect her enormous HP bar.

If you can't wear her down, break her stance.

Analyze your conversations, connect what Kobayakawa-san wants with what you want through the DUAL-LINK SYSTEM, and break her STAGGER.

Then, once her stance is fully broken—

hit her with OVERDRIVE IMPACT.

Your choices can also change the flow of the conversation itself, leading to different exchanges and unexpected situations.

[Edited from [url=https://hokuto1017.itch.io/kobayakawa-san-is-a-soulslike-big]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
用四大战斗指令在心仪女生的对话交锋中杀出重围的三部曲最终完结篇：

轻攻击 / 重攻击 / 弹反 / 翻滚。

只不过这一次，小早川同学变得非常、非常巨大。

你依然可以选择相同的四个战斗指令——但普通攻击几乎撼动不了她那长得离谱的血条。

既然磨不掉她的血，那就击溃她的架势。

剖析你们之间的对话，通过“双重连结系统”（DUAL-LINK SYSTEM）将小早川同学的诉求与你的心意相连，打崩她的架势槽（STAGGER）。

随后，一旦她的架势彻底瓦解——

就用“超载冲击”（OVERDRIVE IMPACT）给予致命一击吧。

你的选择同样会改变对话本身的走向，触发截然不同的交锋与意想不到的展开。

[摘自[url=https://hokuto1017.itch.io/kobayakawa-san-is-a-soulslike-big]itch.io[/url]（经编辑）]
